fixtures.name: Minimal
fixtures.purpose: Small useful page or landing section.
fixtures.stress: Framework overhead, cold-start cost, and minimum payload.
limits: Not representative of dense application UI.

fixtures.name: Docs
fixtures.purpose: Dense article, navigation, code blocks, and tables.
fixtures.stress: Documentation layout, typography, and nested content.
limits: Does not model frequent runtime mutation.

fixtures.name: Dashboard
fixtures.purpose: Repeated cards, tables, filters, charts, and states.
fixtures.stress: Rule reuse, duplicated utilities, and large DOM.
limits: Chart visuals are fixture placeholders, not a chart-library benchmark.

fixtures.name: Stress CSS
fixtures.purpose: Controlled small, medium, and large CSS outputs.
fixtures.stress: Browser style calculation as CSS volume grows.

metrics.label: Style rules
metrics.description: Qualified CSS rules, excluding keyframe step rules.

metrics.label: Selectors
metrics.description: Top-level selectors in qualified style rules.

metrics.label: Declarations
metrics.description: CSS declarations and at-rule descriptors in generated CSS.

metrics.label: Custom properties
metrics.description: Declarations whose property name starts with --.

metrics.label: Important declarations
metrics.description: Declarations emitted with !important.

metrics.label: At-rules
metrics.description: All CSS at-rules in the generated output.

metrics.label: Layer blocks
metrics.description: @layer rules that contain a block.

metrics.label: Media blocks
metrics.description: @media rules that contain a block.

metrics.label: Supports blocks
metrics.description: @supports rules that contain a block.

metrics.label: Container blocks
metrics.description: @container rules that contain a block.

metrics.label: Keyframes
metrics.description: @keyframes and vendor-prefixed keyframes rules.

metrics.label: Unlayered style rules
metrics.description: Qualified style rules not nested under an @layer block.

metrics.label: theme layer style rules
metrics.description: Qualified style rules nested under the theme layer.

metrics.label: base layer style rules
metrics.description: Qualified style rules nested under the base layer.

metrics.label: defaults layer style rules
metrics.description: Qualified style rules nested under the defaults layer.

metrics.label: components layer style rules
metrics.description: Qualified style rules nested under the components layer.

metrics.label: utilities layer style rules
metrics.description: Qualified style rules nested under the utilities layer.

metrics.label: Other layer style rules
metrics.description: Qualified style rules nested under non-standard or anonymous @layer blocks.

metrics.label: Selector combinators
metrics.description: Combinator nodes across top-level selectors.

metrics.label: Max selector specificity score
metrics.description: Maximum selector specificity represented as ID * 100 + class/attribute/pseudo-class * 10 + type/pseudo-element.

metrics.label: Max selector complexity score
metrics.description: Maximum count of selector components and combinators in a top-level selector.

limits: This suite measures generated CSS artifact structure only; it does not measure browser parse, style recalculation, layout, paint, or interaction cost.
Metrics are derived from a CSS AST, not string matching.
Selector specificity and complexity scores are explanatory structure metrics and are not browser timing measurements.
Master CSS and Tailwind CSS fixtures target equivalent rendered UI intent, not identical class strings.
